reviewFlags.text: The source gives Matthew 28:20b in ESV (“And behold, I am with you always, to the end of the age.”). Prepared verse activities propose BSB “And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Review exact translation, word boundaries, and rights.
Approve or edit the 12 suggested incorrect Multiple Choice answer options (six questions).
Approve seven deliberately false statements; ensure statements stay clear and suitable for children.

The source includes a married adult asking Joseph to commit adultery, grabbing his coat, and falsely accusing him of assault. These original source statements are preserved; proposed child-facing modules use simpler language. Review how directly to discuss the events with different age groups.
Check the six Circle the Mistakes changes and their corrections; ensure there are exactly six and no accidental extra errors.
Review the unrelated word suggestions in Odd Words and Checkboxes; lists are intentionally distinct.
Check all six matching pairs for unambiguous single-word associations.
Check four small drawing prompts and six large narrative captions for age suitability and scene variety.
Run repository schema validator, app preflight and all three numbered presets before publication. Ten unique True/False statements are allocated, but renderer/preset behavior has not been tested.
Review the originally quoted Bible teaching and any context-dependent discussion prompts; original source records are preserved while worksheet text is adapted.
